items.label: Open playtest round
items.description: Create today's round post when content is schedulable

items.label: Skip this round
items.description: Void the day's round. Neutral for scores, streaks and leagues.

items.label: Regenerate this round
items.description: Clear an open, unvoted round and create a fresh post.

items.label: Inspect round state
items.description: Show the day's gate, intent, total and projection markers.

items.label: Adopt created post
items.description: Bind the stored post-intent id to the day after an ambiguous create.

items.label: Backfill projections
items.description: Finish result, leaderboard and streak writes for a finalized day.

items.label: Reschedule this week
items.description: Fill this week's remaining empty days from the approved pool.

start-date.label: First day (UTC, yyyy-mm-dd)
start-date.helpText: Day numbering counts up from this UTC date. Storage and cutoff stay UTC.

display-timezone.label: Display timezone (IANA name)
display-timezone.helpText: Only affects how dates and the countdown are labelled in the app.
